audience_note: The approved 13+ minimum is a service audience rule, not an IARC result. The Partner Center questionnaire must rate actual content and interactive elements.

facts.rationale: Shared delivery, history and moderation use the configured coordinator over the internet.
Users record or choose short audio and make it accessible to other invited members.
Audio clips are sent between members of a private Barycenter and can carry arbitrary speech.
Phase 1 destinations are the current Pulsar, the member's Barycenter or its current private air, not a public feed.
Audio is not proactively screened before delivery. Reporting, sender blocking, owner deletion and operator disablement are reactive controls.
The shipped History surface exposes authorized report/block/delete actions and moderation operators can remove or disable content.
Pulsar does not claim a parental-control gate. The service minimum is 13+.
The built-in cue and product-authored UI contain no violence, sexual content, profanity, gambling, drugs or fear content; user audio remains separately disclosed as UGC.
The Phase 1 Windows build has no in-product purchases, loot boxes, wagering or gambling simulation.
The Phase 1 product contains no advertising surface or advertising SDK.
The Phase 1 product does not request location capability or expose user location.
Spotify and Telegram integrations are optional and do not change the primary accountless reviewer path.
